title: Authenticate 4D Mobile Users in 4D and Wakanda
author: Xiang Liu, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents authentication for the original 4D Mobile, which paired 4D Server with a separate Wakanda Enterprise Server layer — an architecture 4D fully replaced with the native 4D Mobile App (iOS/Android) and later ORDA/REST-based web and mobile stacks; the Wakanda dependency makes essentially the entire mechanism obsolete today.
related_updates: Native 4D Mobile App (iOS/Android, ~2016) using 4D Mobile project commands, itself later superseded
Modern REST/ORDA-based authentication (session tokens, `Session` class, `ds.WebServer`) for web/mobile clients
